name: Button
description: An action with six visual variants, three sizes and a loading state.

name: Badge
description: A compact non-interactive status or label.

name: Avatar
description: An image with an accessible fallback for a person or team.

name: Card
description: A surface that groups related content, with optional header and footer.
example: <Card title="Project settings" description="Make this workspace your own.">Your content goes here.</Card>

name: Alert
description: A contextual message with optional assertive announcement.
example: <Alert title="Everything is up to date." variant="success">Your changes have been saved.</Alert>

name: Separator
description: A visual and semantic divider.

name: Skeleton
description: A reduced-motion-aware placeholder while content is loading.

name: Label
description: An explicit label linked to a form control.

name: Kbd
description: A keyboard shortcut hint.

name: Input
description: A text input that inherits the library’s field tokens.

name: Textarea
description: A multiline input with native form semantics.
example: <Textarea aria-label="Project description" placeholder="Tell us about your project…"/>

name: Checkbox
description: A labelled checkbox with checked and indeterminate states.

name: RadioGroup
description: One selection from a labelled set, with arrow-key navigation.

name: Switch
description: An immediate on/off setting with a visible label.

name: Slider
description: A bounded numeric value with keyboard controls and a visible output.

name: Field
description: A labelled field with description, validation and accessible errors.
example: <Field label="Email" description="We’ll use this for account updates."><Input type="email" placeholder="you@company.com"/></Field>

name: InputGroup
description: A text input with leading and trailing content.

name: Select
description: Accessible single or multiple selection with disabled options, controlled state and native form support.
example: <Select label="Timezone" defaultValue="paris" options={[{value:"paris",label:"Europe / Paris"},{value:"new-york",label:"America / New York"}]}/>

name: Combobox
description: Searchable single selection with controlled search, disabled options, optional clearing and form support.

name: Accordion
description: Expandable sections with built-in keyboard interaction.
example: <Accordion items={[{value:"ownership",title:"Do I own the code?",content:"Yes. Export it and use it in your own project."},{value:"runtime",title:"Does it need a server?",content:"The exported components run independently."}]}/>

name: Tabs
description: Related panels connected to an accessible tab list.
example: <Tabs label="Account" items={[{value:"profile",label:"Profile",content:"Your profile settings."},{value:"notifications",label:"Notifications",content:"Choose how you stay informed."}]}/>

name: Collapsible
description: An optional content section with a disclosure trigger.
example: <Collapsible title="Advanced options">Additional settings for this workspace.</Collapsible>

name: Breadcrumb
description: A semantic path through your application.

name: Pagination
description: A controlled page navigator with bounded page selection.

name: Progress
description: A determinate or indeterminate progress bar with a label.

name: Spinner
description: An accessible loading indicator that respects reduced motion.

name: EmptyState
description: A useful empty state with an optional next action.
example: <EmptyState title="No projects yet" description="Create your first project to get started." action={<Button>Create project</Button>}/>

name: Table
description: A semantic table with a caption and responsive overflow.
example: <Table caption="Team members" columns={["Name","Role"]} rows={[["Alex Morgan","Owner"],["Sam Taylor","Developer"]]}/>

name: DataTable
description: Searchable, sortable and paginated data with controlled state, custom cells, stable row keys and loading/empty states.
example: ( {value} ) }, { key: "customer", label: "Customer" }, { key: "amount", label: "Amount", render: value => ( {new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD" }).format(Number(value))} ) }, ]} rows={[ { "id": "INV-1048", "customer": "olivia.martin@example.com", "status": "Paid", "amount": 129 }, { "id": "INV-1047", "customer": "jackson.lee@example.com", "status": "Processing", "amount": 249 }, { "id": "INV-1046", "customer": "sophia.brown@example.com", "status": "Paid", "amount": 89 }, { "id": "INV-1045", "customer": "noah.williams@example.com", "status": "Pending", "amount": 399 }, { "id": "INV-1044", "customer": "ava.robinson@example.com", "status": "Paid", "amount": 149 }, { "id": "INV-1043", "customer": "liam.thompson@example.com", "status": "Refunded", "amount": 79 }, { "id": "INV-1042", "customer": "emma.davis@example.com", "status": "Paid", "amount": 299 }, { "id": "INV-1041", "customer": "lucas.wilson@example.com", "status": "Pending", "amount": 199 } ]} />

name: Dialog
description: A modal dialog with focus management, keyboard dismissal and a labelled title.
example: <Dialog trigger="Open dialog" title="Workspace settings" description="Manage the details of your workspace."><Input aria-label="Workspace name" placeholder="Acme"/></Dialog>

name: AlertDialog
description: A confirmation dialog with focus management, keyboard dismissal and a labelled title.
example: This is a confirmation preview. No data will be changed. In your application, explain the consequences here before asking the user to confirm.

name: Drawer
description: A swipeable drawer with focus management, keyboard dismissal and a labelled title.
example: <Drawer trigger="Open drawer" title="Workspace settings" description="Manage the details of your workspace."><Input aria-label="Workspace name" placeholder="Acme"/></Drawer>

name: Sheet
description: A side panel with focus management, keyboard dismissal and a labelled title.
example: <Sheet trigger="Open sheet" title="Workspace settings" description="Manage the details of your workspace."><Input aria-label="Workspace name" placeholder="Acme"/></Sheet>

name: Popover
description: A non-modal panel anchored to a trigger.

name: Tooltip
description: Additional non-essential text shown on hover or keyboard focus.
example: <Tooltip trigger="Save" content="Save your changes to this library"/>

name: Dropdown
description: A keyboard-accessible menu of actions.

name: ContextMenu
description: A contextual action menu available by right-click or keyboard.

name: HoverCard
description: A preview card for supplementary link information.
example:
Alex Morgan

Designer and developer.

name: NavigationMenu
description: A navigation bar with expandable groups and real link semantics.

name: Sidebar
description: A collapsible application sidebar with active-link semantics.

name: Toggle
description: A pressable on/off button with an accessible pressed state.

name: ToggleGroup
description: A labelled group of toggle buttons with keyboard navigation.

name: NumberField
description: A numeric field with increment, decrement, constraints and locale formatting.

name: Command
description: A searchable command palette with keyboard navigation and real action callbacks.

name: Calendar
description: A Gregorian single-date or range calendar with month/year selection, disabled dates, week numbers and keyboard navigation.
behavior: Date-only ISO values are independent of time zones and display locale.
Arrow keys, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown and Shift+PageUp/PageDown move through days, months and years.
Disabled dates can be listed or supplied as a predicate; range selection can reject unavailable dates inside an interval.
Use `numberOfMonths={2}` for two months and showWeekNumbers for ISO week numbers.

name: DatePicker
description: Single-date and date-range selection with shortcuts, manual confirmation, localized calendars and editable date fields.
example: <DatePicker mode="range" label="Project dates" defaultValue={{start:"2026-09-17",end:"2026-09-23"}} autoApply={false} onValueChange={range=>console.info(range ? range.start + " – " + range.end : "Cleared")}/>
behavior: Single mode returns an ISO date; range mode returns `{ start, end }`. Display formatting never changes stored values.
Choose one or two months, navigate by keyboard or month/year controls, and enter dates directly.
Shortcuts, disabled dates, min/max bounds, week numbers, inline display, clearing and Apply/Cancel are available.
French and English control labels are built in; other languages can supply labels alongside an Intl locale.
The same source and compiled styles are included in the library export.

name: Toast
description: Accessible notifications with a provider, imperative manager and dismiss controls.

name: FileUpload
description: A validated drag-and-drop file input with cancellable upload and real progress callbacks.
